title: Streaming response while streaming request (full-duplex)

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/stream-uppercase")
async def stream_uppercase(request: Request):
    """
    Endpoint that reads the request body as a stream,
    extracts only uppercase letters, and streams them back.
    """

    async def uppercase_generator():
        async for chunk in request.stream():
            text = chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
            uppercase_only = "".join([ch for ch in text if ch.isupper()])
            if uppercase_only:
                yield uppercase_only

    return StreamingResponse(uppercase_generator(), media_type="text/plain")
```


### Description

```
echo "Hello WORLD" > test.txt
curl -X POST --data-binary @test.txt http://localhost:8000/stream-uppercase
```

When I call this I expect that the uppercase letters would be streamed back to me. However, what ends up happening is that the program hangs on line `async for chunk in request.stream()`. I added a print statement inside the loop and I can't anything being printed on the terminal.


### Operating System

macOS

1.10.19

3.10.11

answer.body:
That's correct.

The latest Starlette with Uvicorn supports this.

Unfortunately FastAPI didn't bump the minimum version of Starlette, so you'd need to wait a bit.
